title: Cumberland Campground

services.name: Summer Camps
services.desc: Do you want to make new friends, hike, canoe, kayak, try archery, craft, play, tell tall tales, swim, sing and discover the wonders of Cumberland Lake Park this summer? Join our experienced camp leaders for our week-long camps in July and August. We promise you will leave each day tired and inspired. Check out our Summer Camp Welcome Package for more information. Wriggler Camp is an invitation to our youngest campers. We will explore the beautiful forests and beaches at Cumberland Lake Park at a slower pace than our Scamper and Rambler Camps. Our camp leaders will share age-appropriate games, crafts and activities for a week of outdoor fun! New for 2026! Wriggler Mini Camp now runs Tuesday,

blurb: Cumberland Campground is nestled in the forest, right on Comox lake and only a few minutes drive from downtown Cumberland.
